relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 and RAGE AS-ODN prevented the development of CIPN induced by all three chemotherapy drugs.

relationships.subject: RAGE
relationships.evidence_quote: RAGE AS-ODN, in contrast, reversed CIPN induced by all three chemotherapy drugs.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that increased excitability of small-diameter DRG neurons induced by in vivo and in vitro exposure to oxaliplatin is TLR4-dependent.

key_findings: TLR4 and RAGE antisense ODN prevented CIPN from oxaliplatin, paclitaxel and bortezomib; RAGE AS-ODN reversed all three.
Intrathecal but not intradermal TLR4 antagonist attenuated hyperalgesia, implicating TLR4 at the central terminal.
